criteria.requirement: The policy manifest and conformance schema agree with the normative text.
criteria.evidence: Normative text, policy manifest, schema, and real validating candidate packages exist.
criteria.gap: A complete agreement audit covering every normative policy/schema obligation has not been established by the current pilot evidence.

criteria.requirement: Each profile has an approved owner and review role map.
criteria.evidence: Profiles name primary reviewer roles in the candidate standard and operational Council roles exist.
criteria.gap: An approved owner/review-role map for every profile has not been established by the inspected protected evidence.

criteria.requirement: Mandatory fields have machine-readable definitions and validation tests.
criteria.evidence: The conformance schema defines mandatory fields and current candidate packages pass machine validation.
criteria.gap: Complete field-by-field validation-test coverage for all mandatory semantics has not been established.

criteria.requirement: The exception workflow has fail-closed tests.
criteria.evidence: The normative exception model is fail-closed and defines non-waivable requirements.
criteria.gap: Dedicated exception-workflow adversarial/failure tests have not been established by current protected evidence.

criteria.requirement: Gate records bind to immutable artifact revisions.
criteria.evidence: The admitted GHOS pilot and the four new Stage-A packages bind gate/review records to immutable source or candidate identities.
criteria.gap: This is demonstrated on real packages but has not been established as a complete standard-wide invariant for every admissible record path.

criteria.requirement: Candidate and authoritative source records are distinct in the schema.
criteria.evidence: Software, governance, public, and mathematical Stage-A packages deliberately use distinct candidate supplements over fixed authoritative subjects, preventing candidate status from demoting source authority.
criteria.gap: The current evidence demonstrates the distinction operationally; a complete schema-level distinction covering all source/candidate record forms remains to be established.

criteria.requirement: Orphan detection covers documents, web pages, source records, candidate records, assets, static text, TeX, JSON, and directories where applicable.
criteria.evidence: On Workstream-D PR #798, ci/validate_docs.py rejected the new GCL_TCS_PILOT_MEASUREMENT_001.md page because it was absent from mkdocs.yml navigation, demonstrating a live fail-closed document-to-navigation orphan check.
criteria.gap: The broader required cross-surface coverage for web pages, source/candidate records, assets, static text, TeX, JSON, and directories has not been demonstrated.

criteria.requirement: At least one mathematical, experimental, software, operational, governance, and public artifact has completed a pilot conformance review.
criteria.evidence: Real protected evidence now exists for five of six classes: mathematical LOG-GCD, software GHOS sentinel, operational historical GHOS documentary pilot, governance streamlined execution, and public LOG-GCD exposition.
criteria.gap: The experimental/computational P04 class remains an explicit deficit; no completed non-synthetic P04 result package was verified. The four new Stage-A packages also remain candidate/in_review rather than promoted GCL-TCS artifacts.

criteria.requirement: The pilots record false positives, false negatives, burden, and unresolved ambiguities.
criteria.evidence: GCL-TCS-PILOT-INSTITUTIONALIZATION-001-MEASUREMENT-001 explicitly records false-positive evidence and its limits, false-negative evidence and its limits, operator/reviewer/pilot burden, and unresolved ambiguities, linked to underlying pilot observations.
criteria.gap: Representative empirical false-positive and false-negative rates remain unknown, but the criterion requires these categories to be recorded rather than requiring statistically estimated rates.

criteria.requirement: The Referee approves promotion with an explicit statement of remaining limitations.
criteria.evidence: No version-1.0 promotion is requested by this institutionalization operation.
criteria.gap: A future actual v1.0 proposal would require a fixed candidate revision and the then-governing Referee promotion route. No G8 decision is inferred or manufactured now.

rationale: The pilot has produced useful evidence on claim/source separation, negative evidence, exact material closure, proportional CI, defect detection, and one live document-orphan control.
The P04 class, owner/review-role map, exception fail-closed tests, and broad cross-surface orphan coverage remain material readiness gaps.
The current evidence does not establish optimality or causal research improvement.
Promotion-specific G8/G9 ceremony should not be generated for routine non-promotional pilot evidence; preserve those gates for actual promotion transitions.
simplify_or_automate: shallow evidence discovery and pointer validation
aggregate measurement from pilot observation records
extend orphan detection across the remaining required surfaces
promotion packet generation only on explicit promotion request
future_strengthening_if_naturally_warran: verify a real completed experimental/computational P04 result package
add dedicated fail-closed exception workflow tests
perform a complete normative-text/policy/schema agreement audit before any v1 proposal
